seo_title: Wedding Videographer & Photographer Matlock | Zen Visuals
seo_description: Wedding films and photography in Matlock, Matlock Bath, Cromford and Darley Dale by Zuzia and Ben from Belper. Whole day from £750. Check your date.
h1: Wedding videographer and photographer in Matlock
hero_alt: Bride standing on stone steps among trees
intro: Matlock is twenty minutes up the Derwent valley from us in Belper. The hills, the river and the old mill buildings make it one of the best places in Derbyshire to film a wedding, and we're close enough to know where the light falls at every time of day.
We're Zuzia and Ben. We photograph and film your whole day for one price, and we stay until the dance floor is full.

sections.heading: Weddings around Matlock
sections.text: Couples marrying around Matlock choose places like Cromford Mills, the Whitworth in Darley Dale, Riber Hall, the Grand Pavilion in Matlock Bath, and the churches and chapels in the villages between. We also cover Wirksworth, Tansley, Bonsall and Crich.

sections.heading: Films that use the landscape
sections.text: A Matlock wedding film is built around the valley: the drive up through the gorge, the view from the Heights of Abraham, the river by the mills. We fit portraits around the day so you don't spend it posing.

sections.heading: What you get
sections.text: Wedding photography of your whole day is £750. A 3–6 minute wedding film is £1,100. Both together are £1,650, saving £200. Everything is ready within 3 to 6 weeks.

sections.heading: Twenty minutes from home
sections.text: Matlock, Matlock Bath, Cromford, Darley Dale and Wirksworth are all local to us, so we arrive early, know the venues and never rush the end of the night.

faqs.question: Do you cover weddings in Matlock Bath and Cromford?
faqs.answer: Yes. Matlock, Matlock Bath, Cromford, Darley Dale, Wirksworth and the villages around them are all local to us.

faqs.question: How much does wedding photography cost in Matlock?
faqs.answer: Our wedding photography is £750 for your whole day. A wedding film is £1,100, and both together are £1,650.

faqs.question: Can we have portraits somewhere scenic?
faqs.answer: Yes. If there's a view you love near your venue, we'll plan twenty minutes for it around the light and the running order of your day.
